items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/b9a7d031b53a43aa8de0ac1c2b470455a8a8f34b.png"]

Today’s a huge day for Taxi Life! Not only are we rolling out a brand new update packed with free content and fixes, but we’re also excited to introduce the first officially licensed vehicle in the game! Let’s dive into what’s new.
Gameplay improvements: Mission triggers now appear dynamically as you drive, making passenger pick-ups seamless and natural.
Country Flags: Show off your pride. Decorate your taxi with a variety of national flags completely free.
The iconic Black Cab has officially arrived in Barcelona and here's what makes it unique!
Right-Hand Drive: For the first time in Taxi Life, experience driving from the right side of the cab.
Electric Power: Another EV joins your fleet don’t forget to recharge!
Extra Luggage Space: No front passenger seat means more room for baggage.
A London Classic: Built in the UK, now seen in Barcelona.
You can buy the new LEVC DLC today!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3854360/Taxi_Life_A_City_Driving_Simulator__Black_Cab/"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/188c86487301a03ab965f0aa52fb2e6f76c23379.gif"]
Gameplay Improvements
Added quick recharging via the radial menu.
Fixed bug where passengers only spawned once every 24 hours.
Added periodic contextual tutorial notifications.
Full Repair is now properly permanent, even after customizing your car.
Fixed abnormally large tip amounts appearing in certain challenges.
Vehicles
Black Cab (LEVC TX / Car 10)
Added official LEVC TX DLC vehicle.
Fixed invisible clients inside the cab.
Fixed driver’s hands clipping into steering wheel.
Emergency light now interactable in first-person.
Removed roof sign and updated materials.
Added missing taxi text.
Default color set to black.
Added proper DLC store button and package support for PS5/XSX.
Other Vehicle Fixes
Fixed license plates changing when entering/exiting garage.
Steering wheel colors now update correctly in the garage.
Fixed side mirror behavior during package delivery cutscenes.
Rear light materials for Car 8 now behave correctly.
Fixed tourist trigger zone task colors.
Fixed multiple parade-related issues (AI cars blocking, vehicle stuck ramps).
Fixed access to certain cars in Placa Catalunya.
UI & UX
Added dead zone support for controllers.
Radial Menu now auto-closes at pickup spots.
Fixed map filters not saving correctly in cloud saves.
Fixed overlapping passenger info text in Spanish.
Fixed debug text appearing in passenger info ("Carrer de L'Escar").
Hovered client info no longer stays visible after pickup.
Photo Mode camera behavior improved.
AI & NPCs
Fixed clients waving indefinitely after nearby pickups.
Fixed clients still waving after leaving the zone.
Fixed NPCs in parades not despawning after events.
Improved collision handling with waving clients.
Fixed AI car horns looping infinitely.
Fixed AI cars driving into parades at intersections.
Fixed camera clipping into player car during collisions.
Sound & SFX
Fixed missing SFX when switching tabs with keyboard.
Fixed cleaning/repair/refuel sounds continuing when changing tabs.
Localization
Fixed overlapping text in Spanish passenger info.
General localization updates across languages.
Save System
DLC car prices now display correctly in cloud saves.
Map filters now save and load properly.
Design & Systems
Employees now correctly take sick days.
Fixed acceleration input stacking during end-of-course animations.
Art & Animation
Fixed roof sign visuals and material inconsistencies.
Fixed driver animations during cargo cutscenes.
Fixed access issues for the Victoris car.
Resolved missing SFX after settings changes.

We appreciate each and everyone one of our community members in helping us with bug reporting and improving Taxi Life. We encourage you to continue your support by giving us feedback in our discord channel and stay up to date with the latest news from our teams by following us everywhere.
Check out our last livestream to see our showcase of the patch. We hope you enjoy the update!
Hasta la próxima,
Mike
Simteract Community Manager

items.text: It’s been a few months in the making but we’re happy that we’re finally able to get this update out for everyone. We’ve got bug fixes, free content, and a brand-new DLC release! We have been teasing some of these things for a little bit on our socials so if you have been following along then you know…but for those that don’t. Let’s dive right in

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdxtspW1BU3d9u_Xz-GTgiZVRhteQb_ogSFPCNlIqLLt2Prv29ByIqtsow5GL5FjBF87O09IHoNuOy1ozvM2OFbTSxIXqTiJhUZ3aoajHwj8fXyVuZ7eam1FfloXV-g6UOOf7Hi8g?key=_MY5y6YVzzLVlMi795jTWg"][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfuHfBDyj0tbNPkfxdm_RhGpez1gp5UpgpnnMtptvuZOWe48Z0dd4Wekg4qasHWoKn7dodmTUWK0d8z0-QYI8g8cJsu9cNb1lToYc_W86F69lozHMwPiOt3Yl_Lm5D0iZs-P9QU?key=_MY5y6YVzzLVlMi795jTWg"]
Free with this update, we’re giving the community a free luxury cosmetic pack as a thank you for playing our game. Here’s what you can get
Two new dashboard accessories: a wristwatch and a pocket watch
3 new luxury interior materials
3 high-end exterior materials
A custom gear stick
3 new rim styles to add extra flair to your wheels
Now you can flex your shiny gold paint and stylish rims while cruising the streets of Barcelona.

You can expect a brand new DLC where you’ll be able to pick up tourists and show them interesting points across the map before taking them to their final destination. Make sure you keep them interested, as you will have to balance their interest bar along with driving safely and maintaining their patience as well.

A brand-new car model[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcyhaYctmShWI054h-BKt421P-vJgEOjp9B8DyDXiz6_FHCDNuNWIHCQRtOn7CSrfnKt_5mhQzBqJGQG87siWOWRzoEovQhL7EJ85L4G5murZlpFNqK0BsP3WIwU69JwD-qHubv?key=_MY5y6YVzzLVlMi795jTWg"]
A brand-new game mode built around showcasing Barcelona’s landmarks to visiting tourists

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeohf0a031xYE7NkYeKbDlVSFpnUCz64A1xtNEqzWyd61SLV5cOlFBC1f4CSQlcgDo8qib_6MSpnGg2iVVkPhygrA3HVjHRBHdU89U-sQwddtjuRkBJOWYPgMs5ptxVtmjPHYDc?key=_MY5y6YVzzLVlMi795jTWg"]
This one’s all about putting your driving and tour guide skills to the test.
Here are some key bug fixes we’ve added into the game over the last few months.
UI & Gameplay
Fixed an issue where the game could freeze after multiple save reloads
Controller and keyboard focus now works properly in the Garage tab switching
Tutorial input bug fixed—no more ghost button presses
Incorrect parking pop-up no longer appears after finishing a job
Package icons from old deliveries no longer show up in new jobs
Fixed the tip amount for completed taxi jobs—it now reflects your performance
Experience and money now correctly saved by autosave after finishing a course
Mouse/keyboard inputs now behave correctly when switching during Pause Menu
Fixed issues with photo mode and driver visibility in FPP
Map & Navigation
Improved the look of curved roads on the minimap
Fixed issues with invisible collisions during parade events
Blocked access to unintended areas like the opening near Plaça de Ramon Berenguer el Gran
Fixed pointer snapping to cabin elements in FPP mode
AI & Events
AI now behaves better around parade events—no more crashes or floating pedestrians
Fixed collision bugs with parades near Carrer de Jaume Vicens i Vives
Parallax AI vehicles no longer break the immersion (or themselves)
Crashes & Stability
Fixed rare PS5 crash after canceling a job
Fixed XSX crash when reverting system settings
Fixed crash when showcasing landmarks
Fixed issue where cars would launch into the air if tourists were being shown landmarks with AI nearby
Misc
Fixed digital speedometer missing on the Victoris’ dashboard
Fixed hand brake input not registering after pause menu use
Cleaned up UI popups, duplicated landmark showcases, and avatar switching issues
And a lot more small tweaks and polish!

As always for your continued support for Taxi Life. We’re loving the community's passion and feedback so keep it coming! Make sure to hop into our Discord and follow us on socials to stay on top of upcoming updates and content drops.
See you in Barcelona!
The Simteract Team

The day has arrived. The long awaited patch 5 is finally out and we’re happy to see all the hype surrounding it. If you want more details like videos and a deeper explanation of each feature we added we talked about everything in our previous blog here. Otherwise, let's dive into the notes.
Photo Mode - We added a photo mode so our players can take dope screenshots of their pimped out vehicles like Xzibit. You can adjust the temperature, zoom levels, film grain and much more. Have fun!
Mouse steering - A long requested accessibility feature. This will allow players to use the mouse to more precisely steer the vehicle when playing with a mouse + keyboard.
Alternative quicklook - Now, an alternative quicklook mode will be introduced:
Quick Look OFF
Right stick for free look.
LB + right stick for quick look.
Quick Look On
Right stick for a quick look.
LB + right stick for free look.
You'll be able to find this switch in the settings menu and choose which style fits you best.
Hide the HUD + Center DOT - You can access this new feature in the System Settings > Video > Presence of HUD

Go back to Practice mode - Players that want to brush up on their driving skills in a safe and non-chaotic environment can now go back into the driving school and do so. Feel free to master those 3 point turns, without the intensity of other drivers honking at you.
Pedestrian walking loops at narrow crossroads in two districts have been fixed.
Pedestrians now stop at red lights when crossing in certain districts.
Pedestrians no longer pass through trees next to the Umbracle.
Issues with pedestrians navigating the stairs along Pg. Marítim de la Barceloneta have been resolved.
Pedestrians no longer pass through walls at specific spots on de Rosa Sensat.
Clipping with terrain in the middle of Pg. de Joan de Borbó has been fixed.
Pedestrians no longer clip through trees next to Pça. de Pau Vila.
Clipping with a low fence at the entrance to Rda. de Sant Antoni has been addressed.
Pedestrians sitting at tables near the café no longer clip into buildings in the alley between Carrer de Tamarit and Rda. de Sant Pau.
Clipping with buildings at Passeig de Circumvaŀlació has been resolved.
Pedestrians no longer clip through the pavement when walking across train tracks.
Low obstacle collision issues for pedestrians have been fixed.
Pedestrians can now cross the street on Carrer de la Drassana without issue.
Floating and clipping issues near the Garage have been addressed.
Cars no longer attempt U-turns on Carrer de Freixures and drive into Santa Caterina Market.
AI vehicles no longer drive onto walls after Big RoadWorks spawn on Av. Marques De L'Argentera.
AI cars no longer block each other near the Military Parish Church of La Ciutadella.
Blocking issues with AI cars turning onto Carrer de la Princesa have been resolved.
The game no longer crashes during the cutscene of picking up a challenge client after prolonged gameplay.
The dot at the center of the screen now fades out correctly when using the 3rd person camera view.
The correct voiceover plays for the female client during dialogue about the bug on the window.
The 'Select' button no longer resets ON/OFF settings.
The "Device Type" now stays on the selected device after quitting the settings menu.
The hint related to the special button press can no longer be triggered in the pause menu.
Redundant '[ ]' has been removed from the earning graph when the language is set to Spanish.
"Shift up" and "shift down" translations on the controls screen have been corrected for the Catalonian language.
Weight and gearbox are now properly displayed in the 'PARTS' tab.
Debug strings no longer appear when switching tabs in the radial menu using the steering wheel.
The speed limit settings on the main road between 2 districts have been fixed.
Placeholder strings no longer appear in the quit game confirmation window.
Ens veiem a Barcelona,
The Simteract Team

items.text: It's patch day! We're happy to announce that patch 4 has been implemented into Taxi Life and with that, you'll be able to experience new features and improvements for the game. This announcement will be a more condensed version of what we talked about last week, and if you want to see detailed explanation of each feature and update, click here to check out our developer blog.
New Updates and Features
Speed limit sign on the minimap: Drivers will now be able to see the speed limit sign on the minimap, making it easier to see how fast you should be going.
Continuous improvements of AI (car traffic, pedestrians, and AI car physics-based): AI peds are now less keen on trying to get ran over by cars and stepping in the way of players.
Presets for steering wheels: Drivers will now be able to use preset wheel bindings for some of the most popular steering wheel models.
Improved forced feedback (FBB): It will now be easier for Drivers to choose their desired level of FBB.
Adjustable cabin camera position settings: Drivers will be able to adjust the in-cabin camera position to their preferred position.

Adjustable events and traffic spawning density: Drivers will now be able to adjust the amount of events and traffic density in the world. (dev note: please make sure your PC can handle higher density situations)
Informational window when clutch/shifter users: This is for Drivers that connect a shifter to play Taxi Life, it will have vital information on how to get it working.
Various bug fixes: We have fixed various bugs reported by the players and the team.

To the entire Taxi Life community and on behalf of the Simteract team, we wanted to thank you for your continued support for our game. We are not done yet. We still have many more things to add to Taxi Life which includes future DLC, steering wheel support for consoles and more.
We hope you enjoy the improvements in this patch and make sure to follow us on socials and join our Discord channel to stay up to date with the latest news from our team.
Ens veiem a barcelona!
The Simteract Team

It's been a long time coming. The community has been asking and we've been listening. We're very happy to finally announce that PC players for Taxi Life will be able to use all steering wheel models*** with the game starting from today's patch. We wanted to go into a bit more detail on some of the in's and outs of the new binding menu, so lets get into it:

First, we'd like to start off by mentioning that we would advise for players to have there steering wheels plugged into their computer, before launching the game so the game can detect your device. Keep this in mind with multiple devices as well.
After you connected your peripherals, and then launched your game you can access the binding menu from the pause menu.
Click on ESC > Game Settings > Controls > Click on the right arrow to navigate to steering wheel binding menu
Once you’re in the Controls menu, you can select your preferred steering wheel. Here are the key steps:
Choose your steering wheel/device from the list.
Toggle the custom setup option to on
Note: Setting the custom setup to on ensures full functionality, while off mode provides a simplified setup.
Double-check all connections.
Make sure all correct drivers are installed and updated
Ensure that all devices are connected before launching the game.
Reconnecting devices during gameplay may not always result in proper detection and might require restarting the game.
When correctly connected, your devices should appear in the game’s device list with their specific names (e.g., Thrustmaster T300). Here are some additional details:
You can connect more than one device at a time.
If your steering wheel does not work right out of the box, use the custom binding setup to bind all of the buttons.
After plugging in your steering wheel and you do not get FFB (Forced Feedback), please try and restart the game.
For the best experience, use the custom setup for all connected peripherals. If you encounter any issues or need further assistance please ping us on our official Discord channel

We've also included in this patch some minor bug fixes that players should not be bothered by any more. If you encounter anything new, don't hesitate to let us know. We have 2 more patches to be released, but this does not mean we’re done! We’re going to be working on adding more content to the game within this year.

Shoutouts to the entire Simteract/Nacon teams for working hard on bringing this patch live as well as to the community for all of their constructive feedback since the games release. Without you guys, we couldn’t have made it this far. We have a lot more coming for Taxi Life, so stay tuned folks. We're not done by a long shot.
See you in Barcelona, drivers!
Mike
Simteract Community Manager

items.text: This week's patch focuses on enhancing your driving experience with important wheel support adjustments, critical bug fixes, and improvements that the players have been letting us know about.
G29 & G920 Support: We've implemented fixes for both G29 and G920 wheel support, ensuring a more responsive and immersive driving experience.
Force Feedback on flat Roads: Adjustments have been made to the force feedback on flat roads, enhancing the players control over the vehicle while using a steering wheel.
AI Improvements: Fixes have been applied to both Car’s AI and Pedestrians’ AI.
Language Stuttering Fix: We’ve addressed the stuttering issues encountered in Japanese, Korean, Simplified and traditional Chinese languages.
Traffic Law Adherence: The frequency of AI drivers ignoring red lights has been reduced, promoting a safer and more law-abiding city environment.
Illumination Adjustments: We’ve toned down the illumination effects caused by the player's car lights.
Floating AI Vehicles: The occurrence of floating AI vehicles has been reduced.
Management issue: Fixed the issue when the player was unable to change employee's starting hour without switching district during shift assignment
Minor fixes to the menus navigation

As always - we wanted to thank the community in providing invaluable feedback. We encourage to keep it coming and we wanted to remind everyone that our community managers, developers and other management are always monitoring what the players are writing about. Your voices are being heard and we are rolling out patches, improvements and eventually more content for Taxi Life. We have a roadmap in the works that will give the players a better idea of the direction that we're going in with Taxi Life.
With that being said, on behalf of Nacon and Simteract - thank you for playing Taxi Life and your continued support for our game.
Ens veiem a Barcelona,
Mike
Simteract Community Manager

items.text: We're excited to announce the latest patch for Taxi Life to the community. We're bringing you a host of improvements and community-requested features to make your experience playing Taxi Life more enjoyable. Without further ado, let's dive into the details of what's included in today's update.

Reduced instances of framerate stuttering, ensuring smoother gameplay for all drivers navigating the bustling streets of our city. Slight stuttering issues can still be occurring in some areas, the team is still working on it for a next patch.
Resolved issues leading to fewer collisions from AI cars into player's, making for a more realistic driving environment.

Introducing a helpful tooltip hint feature! Press LB/L1 on your gamepad to discover which controller inputs can be combined to execute specific actions. For seamless integration, restore Controls to default in the SYSTEM SETTINGS menu under the CONTROLS tab using the "Reset to default" function.

Addressed various issues related to AI cars, GPS functionality, Settings menu navigation, environmental elements, car damage mechanics, and audio performance, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable driving experience overall.
NPC taxis are now cruising the city streets, adding an extra layer of realism to your driving adventures 🚖

On behalf of Simteract and Nacon, we wanted to also thank the entire community for their continued support and passion for Taxi Life. A game that we have been putting our hearts and souls in for the last 2-3 years - making it all worth it in the end. We encourage the community to keep the feedback coming on our Discord, social media and Steam. We have more stuff planned for PC and beyond, so stay tuned!
On that note, we hope you all enjoy the patch!
Ens veiem a Barcelona,
Mike
Simteract Community Manager
